cases.name: bekensteinBits
cases.source: Bekenstein 1973 bound: N = 2*pi*R*E/(hbar*c*ln2), computed independently with the tool's own declared constants (HBAR=1.055e-34, C=2.998e8) for R=1e4 m, E=1e9 J

cases.name: landauerOps
cases.source: Landauer 1961 erasure bound: ops/s = P/(kB*T*ln2), computed independently with KB=1.381e-23 for P=1e9 W, T=2.7 K

cases.name: lloydOps
cases.source: Lloyd 2000, Nature 406: ops/s from energy = 2*E/(pi*hbar), computed independently with HBAR=1.055e-34 for E=1e9 J
